description: This file defines the code-behind for the AdminCourseQueue page of the Online Examination System, handling page events and navigation actions such as button clicks and grid view selection.

classes.name: AdminCourseQueue
classes.description: A web page class responsible for managing the course queue in the admin section of the online exam system.

methods.description: Handles the event when the home button is clicked, navigating to the admin panel.
